title: Width+batch-size stack (finally run)
description: Changed TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**18 on top of the ASPECT_RATIO=96 baseline (DEPTH=8), doubling optimizer steps at the wider model width; grad_accum_steps auto-halved, no other changes.
reflection: The stack was real and additive: val_bpb 0.982786 vs baseline 0.998671, a ~1.6% improvement, consistent with the round-0 individual effects of width (0.998671) and batch-size (1.001440) combining favorably. This is the experiment that 11-12 proposals across two rounds called for but nobody executed until now, because everyone kept assuming someone else in the pile-up would run it and pivoted away. Lesson for the group: when everyone converges on the same idea, someone should just commit and run it rather than treating unanimity as a reason to defect to something else.
